prs.title: Gracefully terminate active sessions during StreamableHTTP shutdown

prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled on shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. (2 PRs)
